messages:
Ava (People Ops): Heads up — midcycle comp change window closes next Friday. Managers: please upload evidence for any exceptions by COB Thu.
Jordan (Eng Mgr): @Ava what's the minimum evidence we need for a comp change outside the normal band? A short bullet list helps.
Ava (People Ops): Good Q. Ideally: 1) concrete impact examples (metrics or customer outcomes), 2) peer/manager calibration note, 3) proposed new band/level and salary target, 4) timeline when the work started. One doc per candidate.
Sam (IC): For impact examples, is a PR count or # of incidents fixed acceptable? Or do you prefer business metrics?
Ava (People Ops): Business metrics > proxy metrics if available. If not, operational improvements ok but explain downstream value.
Jordan (Eng Mgr): Also, if the change is approved retroactive, how is backpay calculated? FYI @Ben
Ben (Finance): Backpay is from the approval effective date we set in People Ops. We calculate delta between old and new salary for the number of days since effective date, prorated. Bonuses/stock not included automatically — we handle on a case-by-case.
Priya (Recruiter): Quick note — if you request a band change that affects hiring comps, flag Recruiting. We need lead time to adjust offers in flight.
Jordan (Eng Mgr): Is there a template for the evidence doc?
Ava (People Ops): Yes — see the sample in the handbook: /handbook/people-ops/comp-change-template.md. TL;DR: 1-paragraph summary, bullets for impact, suggested comp, comp justification, manager sign-off.
Sam (IC): Can I add peer feedback directly in the doc or should managers collate?
Ava (People Ops): Managers should collate. If you want to share peer notes, send to your manager and they can attach anonymized excerpts.
Jordan (Eng Mgr): Deadline reminder — if we miss this window, will comp changes be delayed to next cycle?
Ava (People Ops): Usually yes. We can approve exceptions for urgent retention risks but they'll need stronger evidence and sponsor from a director.
Jordan (Eng Mgr): If approved, what's the turnaround time for payroll/offer updates?
Ben (Finance): Payroll changes feed into the next payroll run; typical turnaround is 1-2 payroll cycles after final approval. For immediate retention offers, Recruiting + Finance coordinate to issue an offer letter parallel to payroll.
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled — Upload evidence by 2026-04-02 17:00 PT to the Comp Change folder: drive.company.com/comp_changes/midcycle2026
Priya (Recruiter): @Jordan if you want me to pre-author candidate offer ranges, DM and I can reserve bands for 72 hours while you finalize.
Jordan (Eng Mgr): Thanks everyone. I'll start drafting docs for Sam + two others and ping @Ava for early feedback.
Ava (People Ops): Happy to review early drafts. Send via DM or drop a link here and I'll skim.
Jordan (Eng Mgr): linking the draft here shortly.
